messages:
ana: Quick PM follow-up from the incident postmortem. We keep seeing repeating pages from the same root cause. Need owners for dedupe, thresholds, and archive of low-signal alerts. Short plan please.
oncall-bot: Postmortem: https://redwood/pm/incident-789 (timeline + raw alerts).
matt: Raw samples show same trace_id repeating with tiny timing offsets. Dedupe by trace_id + route would remove many dupes.
jess: Agree. Also moving thresholds from static to baseline-based (95p over last 30d windows) should reduce burst noise. I can prototype.
leo: I can implement dedupe rule and run a replay test. Plan: PR -> staging canary 48h -> prod with mirror. ETA PR Mon.
samir: Canary safety: keep mirror (no paging) + high-severity bypass (>5% error rate) so we don't suppress real incidents. I'll own rollback plan and monitoring checks.
matt: Prototype rule (staging):
```
alert_rule {
  name: "http-5xx-dedupe"
  dedupe_key: ["trace_id","route"]
  window: "5m"
  mirror: true
}
```
jess: Also recommend we archive alerts with <2 hits in 90d and no owner. Converts them to metrics-only dashboards.
nana: (cc @ana) typo.
nana: ignore me.
nana: (reacts :sweat_smile:)
nana: back on topic.
nana: Assigning owners: leo - dedupe (PR Mon), jess - thresholds (analysis Wed), matt - archive inventory (next week), samir - canary & rollback (tests Tue).
nana: Timeline: PRs this week, 48h staging canary next week, prod gated on mirror vs baseline comparison. Add PR links to postmortem doc.
leo: PR opened: https://redwood/repo/pulls/999 (includes replay tests).
matt: Inventory draft: https://redwood/docs/alerts/inventory-archival (WIP).
samir: Rollback checklist posted to docs repo.
jess: Threshold eval in my branch, will add precision/recall numbers.
nana: Please drop a 1-line update in this thread when each step completes so I can update the action tracker. Reconvene Thurs for 15m sync. :white_check_mark:
